newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends stronger vs dlr, NBH basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends stronger vs dlr, NBH basket.

text.p: 1215 GMT - Hungary's forint closed firmer on Friday as the mark also firmed versus the U.S. currency and an early wave of foreign currency buyings passed, dealers said.
* The forint ended at 161.45/55 to one dollar, up from its opening of 161.50/70.
* The forint ended some 25 pips weaker than the central bank (NBH) resistance level, compared with 50 fillers at the opening and Friday's 80-pip bottom, at 162.20 to one dollar.
* The forint moved hecticly due to foreign currency buyings by three banks on an otherwise almost empty pre-holiday market, dealers said.
